categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: Life Sciences, In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD), and Biopharmaceuticals. Its product portfolio includes basic research reagents, high-throughput sequencing reagents, diagnostic raw materials, laboratory consumables and instruments, diagnostic reagents and instruments, pharmaceutical research reagents, GLP-1 raw materials, vaccine evaluation reagents and raw materials, and Contract Research Organization (CRO) technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary core technology platforms including protein directed evolution, single B-cell high-performance antibody discovery, large-scale multi-system recombinant protein production, and quantum dot modification coupled with multiplex detection technology. It employs molecular biology, enzymology, immunology, bioinformatics, organic chemistry, and materials science for R&D. Production includes high-density fermentation, recombinant protein expression in multiple systems (bacteria, yeast, mammalian cells), and automated manufacturing processes with GMP-compliant facilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers span research institutions, high-throughput sequencing service providers, molecular diagnostic reagent manufacturers, pharmaceutical and vaccine companies, CROs, hospitals, third-party testing centers, animal husbandry enterprises, and animal quarantine agencies. The company serves markets in scientific research, clinical diagnostics, pharmaceutical and vaccine R&D, animal health, and molecular diagnostics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive domestic sales and production facilities. It has established subsidiaries and operations in North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, Australia, and other regions, including local subsidiaries in the US, Canada, Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Indonesia, UK, South Korea, and Australia. It maintains overseas warehouses in the US, Hungary, and Singapore to support global distribution.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly upstream and midstream in the biotechnology supply chain, focusing on the development and production of core raw materials such as enzymes, antigens, antibodies, and chemical reagents. It also extends downstream by producing end-use diagnostic reagents, instruments, and providing CRO services, thus covering a broad spectrum from raw material supply to finished product delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes original innovation and foundational technology breakthroughs, focusing on expanding downstream large single-product markets such as respiratory pathogen detection, high-value chemiluminescence indicators, GLP-1 raw materials, and microfluidic systems. R&D priorities include AI-assisted protein design, high-throughput sequencing technologies, POCT diagnostics, molecular diagnostics, vaccine evaluation, mRNA raw materials, and synthetic biology. The company invests heavily in R&D, with over 700 R&D personnel and continuous patent applications and authorizations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of biological reagents, diagnostic reagents, instruments, consumables, and technical services including CRO and antibody discovery. Sales channels include direct sales and distribution networks domestically and internationally. The company also earns income from government subsidies and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China’s biotechnology sector, particularly in molecular biology reagents, molecular diagnostic raw materials, and high-throughput sequencing reagents, holding top market shares among domestic manufacturers. It competes with multinational corporations like Thermo Fisher Scientific, Roche, and Qiagen, especially in the imported product replacement market. The company is recognized for its strong R&D capabilities and growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.38 billion, a 7.15% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 18.09 million, showing significant reduction in losses compared to prior years. Total assets were RMB 5.05 billion with net assets of RMB 3.95 billion. The company maintains a high R&D investment ratio (~21.8% of revenue) and has demonstrated steady growth in new product lines and international markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary core technology platforms enabling rapid, scalable, and high-quality production of enzymes, antibodies, and reagents with performance at or above international standards. It offers comprehensive solutions integrating reagents, consumables, and instruments, with a focus on innovation, product quality, and supply chain security. Its AI-driven protein design and high-throughput screening enhance product performance and development speed, supporting customers in research, diagnostics, and biopharmaceutical development with differentiated, high-value products.
